skills.name: Fishing
skills.description: Calm catch-and-release fishing. Each catch releases Waterside wisps toward the well, may fill your journal, and very rarely reveals a finished shore tile.

skills.name: Woodland Tending
skills.description: Prune and tend placeable living trees. Each pruning releases Grove wisps toward the well; the tree rests briefly, then recovers wherever you planted it.

skills.name: Mining
skills.description: Stonebound land hums under the pick. (Coming with the mountain update — the hooks are already alive.)
